n-k-l1b-02.title: Har'a Hana bas kam fudhatti?
n-k-l1b-02.topic: Hangul jireenya dhugaa keessatti: gabatee dhaabbata basii
n-k-l1b-02.goal: Odeeffannoon gabatee basii fi barreeffama keessa jiru kam bas sirrii maqaa kaa'uuf barbaachisaa akka ta'e murteessi, haala qabxii keessatti maxxanfame hubadhu, filannoo kee ibsi.
n-k-l1b-02.material:
Atii fi hiriyaan kee Hana dhaabbata basii 시장 앞 jedhamu irra jirtu. Guyyoota: 월 Wix, 화 Qib, 수 Rob, 목 Kam, 금 Jim, 토 San, 일 Dil. 매일 = guyyaa hundumaa.

3번 (월~금): 학교 · 병원

n-k-l1b-02.prereq.1: Maqaa guyyoota torbanii (월 ~ 일), lakkoofsa + 번 beeka
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.prompt: Lakkoofsa basii Hana'tti himuuf odeeffannoon kam si barbaachisa? Hundumaa filadhu.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.hint.0: Duraan Hana maal gochuu akka barbaaddu barreessi, achiis kutaan gabatee kam deebii akka kennu gaafadhu.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.hint.1: Wanta lakkoofsa basii hundaa booda qabxii keessatti barreeffame dubbisi. Har'a waa'ee maaliin fayyadamuuf si barbaachisa?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.r.b: Ati duraanuu dhaabbata irra jirta. Gabateen maqaa maaliyyuu yoo ta'e wal-fakkaata, kanaaf maqaan dhaabbataa basii hin murteessu.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.r.e: Gatiin bas gara iddoo sanaa deemu hin jijjiiru, gabateen gatii tokkollee hin agarsiisu.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.explain: Iddoo (병원), sararoota gabatee isa tarreessan, fi guyyaa har'aa si barbaachisa, sababni 3번 월~금 qofa deemuu. Maqaan dhaabbataa fi kaffaltiin lakkoofsa filachuuf hin gargaaran.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.prompt: Har'a Hana bas kam fudhachuu qabdi?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bassoota tarreeffamni isaanii iddoo sana hin eeriin haqi.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bassoota hafaniif, qabxii guyyaa har'aa wajjin ilaali.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.r.a: 3번 gara 병원 deema, garuu qabxiin 월~금 qofa deema jedha, har'a immoo 일요일 dha.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.r.b: 7번 gara 시장 fi 학교 deema. 병원 tarreeffama isaa keessa hin jiru.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.r.d: Lamaan 병원 tarreessu, garuu 3번 har'a hin deemu, kanaaf wal-qixa miti.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s2.explain: 5번 병원 tarreessa fi 매일 deema. 3번 illee 병원 tarreessa garuu 월~금 qofa deema, har'a immoo Dilbata.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.prompt: Hana'tti Afaan Ingiliffaatiin deebisi (jechoota Koreaa dabaluu dandeessa): bas kam fudhachuu qabdi, bas gara sanatti deemu inni kaan maaliif miti?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.hint.0: Duraan lakkoofsa basii himi, achiis sababa hima tokkoon.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.hint.1: Guyyaa barreeffama har'aa keessa jiru fi qabxii bas kaan irra jiru eeri.

n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Bas kaan har'a maaliif akka hin hojjenne himeeraa?
n-k-l1b-02.s.s3.model.0: Bas 5 fudhadhu. Bas 3 gara hospitaalaa deema, garuu Wiixata hanga Jimaata qofa deema, har'a immoo Dilbata.

n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Durba, sababni 지민 maqaa durbaa fakkaata.

n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 지훈 isa guddaa dha. Wanti guddaan gurbaa dha jedhu hin jiru, isa xiqqaa irrattis homaa hin jedhamne.
n-k-l1b-03.s.s1.reflect: Maqaan maqaa maatii fi maqaa kennamee agarsiisa, namoonni wal-qabatan ykn nama tokko gurbaa moo durba ta'uu hin agarsiisu. Odeeffannoon haaraan tokkoon tokkoon beekumsa keenya xiqqeesse, 'danda'ama' fi 'mirkanaa'e' addaan qabanne.

n-k-l1c-01.title: Suuraa keessatti eenyutu eenyuun barsiisa?
n-k-l1c-01.topic: Mata duree, meeshaa fi mallattoo: eenyutu maal hojjeta
n-k-l1c-01.goal: Katabbiiwwan suuraa wajjin simatan murteessi, mallattoo kee katabbii haaraa irratti qori, maaliif katabbiin wal fakkaatu faallaa jechuu akka ta'e ibsi.
n-k-l1c-01.material: Suuraan gaazexaa kutaa tokko ni qaba: 수진 민수 tiif suuraa baasuu barsiisaa jirti. Barattoonni shan katabbii yaadu. Jechoota: 가르쳐요 = barsiisa. Mallattoota: 이/가 nama hojjetu duubaan ni dhufa; 은/는 mata duree duubaan ni dhufa ("as for ..."); 을/를 nama gochi irratti raawwatamu duubaan ni dhufa.
n-k-l1c-01.thinking.0: Gahee mallattoodhaan addaan baasuu, bakkaan miti
n-k-l1c-01.thinking.2: Seera nama tartiiba jecha Ingliffaa yaaduuf ibsuu
n-k-l1c-01.prereq.1: 이/가 fi 을/를 (nama hojjetu fi fudhatu) argeera
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.prompt: Suuraa keessatti, 수진 민수 barsiisa. Katabbiin kam suuraa kana ibsa? Hunda filadhu.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.hint.0: Maqaawwan bitaa gara mirgaatti hin dubbisin. Duraan maqaan kam 이/가 ykn 은/는 qabu fi kam 을/를 qabu argi.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.hint.1: Katabbii hundaaf gaafadhu: eenyutu maqaa booda 를 (ykn 을) qaba, nama sun barsiifama moo barsiisa?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.r.b: Mallattoon 가 민수 irra jira, kanaaf asitti 민수 barsiisaa dha. Kun suuraa faallaa dha.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.r.d: 수진 duraan dhufa, garuu 을 수진 irra jira: isheen barsiifamti, 민수 immoo barsiisa. Tartiibni mallattoo miti.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.explain: a, c fi e keessatti, 수진 이/가 ykn 은/는 qabdi (nama hojjettu ykn mata duree), 민수 immoo 를 qaba (nama barsiifamu). Tartiibni maqaa lamaanii jijjiiramuu danda'a; mallattoonni gahee eegu.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.prompt: Katabbiin haaraan mul'ata: 동생을 엄마가 안아요. (안아요 = hammata, 엄마 = haadha, 동생 = obboleessa/obboleettii xiqqaa.) Eenyutu eenyuun hammata?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tartiiba osoo hin dubbisin dura maqaa tokkoon tokkoon isaa booda mallattoo argi.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gaafadhu mallattoon kam nama gocha hojjetu mallatteessa fi kam nama fudhatu.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.a: 엄마 동생 hammata, sababni isaa 엄마 가 qaba, 동생 immoo 을 qaba.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.b: 동생 엄마 hammata, sababni isaa 동생 maqaa jalqabaa himicha keessa jiru dha.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.b: Maqaan jalqabaa ofiin ofiin nama hojjetu miti. 동생 을 qaba, kanaaf 동생 nama hammatamu dha.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.c: Wal hammatu, sababni isaa maqaan lamaan mallattoo qabu.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.c: Mallattoon lamaan garaagara. 가 nama hammatu mallatteessa, 을 immoo nama hammatamu.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.d: Himuu hin dandeenyu, sababni isaa maqaawwan tartiiba hin idilee ta'e keessa jiru.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.d: Himuu ni dandeessa: mallattoonni tartiiba yoo jijjiirame illee gahee eegu.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.explain: 가 엄마 irra jira (nama hammatu) 을 immoo 동생 irra jira (nama hammatamu), kanaaf katabbiin haadha obboleessa/obboleettii ishee xiqqoo hammata jechuu dha. Mallattoonni, tartiiba osoo hin ta'in, gahee kennu.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.prompt: Hiriyyaan tartiiba jecha Ingliffaa dubbisa, "수진을 민수가 가르쳐요 starts with 수진, so 수진 teaches" jedha. Himoota Ingliffaa tokko ykn lama keessatti, maaliif katabbiin kun suuraa wajjin hin simanne ibsi.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.hint.0: Mallattoo 수진 bira jiru fi mallattoo 민수 bira jiru agarsiisi.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.hint.1: Mallattoon tokkoon tokkoon isaa gahee maqaa isaa maal akka himu jedhi.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mallattoo 수진 irra jiru maqaa kenneeraa?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Katabbii kana keessatti eenyutu barsiisa jedheeraa?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.0: 수진 mallattoo 을 qabdi, kanaaf isheen nama barsiifamtu; 민수 가 qaba, kanaaf 민수 barsiisa. Bakki murteessuu hin dandeenye.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.1: Mallattoonni gahee agarsiisu, tartiiba miti: 을 수진 nama fudhatu godha, 가 민수 nama hojjetu godha, kanaaf 민수 수진 barsiisa jedha.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.2: Sababni isaa 가 민수 nama barsiisu akka ta'e agarsiisa.

n-k-l1c-02.title: 민호 eessatti maal hojjeta? Qorannoo gaazexaa
n-k-l1c-02.topic: Mallattoo bakkaa: 에 (deemuu, jiraachuu) vs 에서 (hojjechuu)
n-k-l1c-02.goal: Dayarii gabaabaa keessaa sararoota mallattoon bakkaa dogoggoraa itti fayyadame argi, seera 에 fi 에서 addaan baasu himi, sararoota sirreessi.
n-k-l1c-02.material: Barataan 민호 jedhamu guyyaa isaa Afaan Koreaatiin barreessa. Mallattoon bakkaa tokko tokko dogoggora. Jechoota: 아침 = ganama, 점심 = laaqana, 오후 = waaree booda, 저녁 = galgala, 운동해요 = shaakala.
n-k-l1c-02.thinking.0: Dogoggora seera wajjin sarara hundaa mirkaneessuudhaan argachuu
n-k-l1c-02.prereq.1: 에 fi 에서 akka jiran beeka (mallattoo bakkaa)
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.prompt: Kun dayarii 민호 guyyaa tokkoo dha. Sararoonni tokko tokko dogoggora mallattoo bakkaa qabu (tokko ol jira). Sarara kam illee dogoggora qabu filadhu.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara hundaa keessaa gochaa fi mallattoo bakkaa sararaa. Sararoonni kam wal fakkaatu?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sararoota gochaa isaaniitiin garee garee godhi, garee tokkoon tokkoon mallattoo kam akka fayyadamu ilaali.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.explain: Sararoonni 3, 5 fi 7 dogoggora: 도서관에서 책을 읽어요 (gocha bakka tokko irratti), 집에 있어요 (bakka tokko jiraachuu), 공원에서 운동해요 (gocha bakka tokko irratti). Sararoonni 1, 2, 4 fi 6 gaarii dha.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.prompt: Seerri kam garaagarummaa 에 fi 에서 dayarii kana keessatti ibsa?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sararoota sirrii gochaa isaaniitiin garee godhi: gochoonni kam 에 wajjin, kam 에서 wajjin deemu?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gaafadhu: gochichi nama sun socho'a ykn jiraata jedhaa, moo nama sun bakka sana wanta hojjeta?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.a: 에 bakka gochi itti raawwatamu agarsiisa; 에서 bakka namni itti deemu ykn jiru agarsiisa.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.a: Kun jijjiiramaa dha. 학교에 가요 (deemuu) fi 식당에서 먹어요 (nyaachuu) ilaali.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.b: 에 bakka guddaa akka mana barumsaa tiif; 에서 bakka xiqqaa akka kutaa tiif.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.b: Guddinni hin barbaachisu: 학교에서 fi 집에서 lamaanuu gocha tiif gaarii dha.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.c: 에 fi 에서 hiika wal fakkaatu qabu; kam iyyuu gocha kamiyyuu wajjin hojjeta.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.c: Isaan garaagara dha: 도서관에 책을 읽어요 Koreeyoota biratti dogoggora dhaga'ama.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.d: 에서 bakka gochi itti raawwatamu agarsiisa; 에 bakka namni itti deemu ykn jiru agarsiisa.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.explain: 에서 = bakka wanta itti hojjettu (nyaachuu, dubbisuu, qorachuu, shaakaluu). 에 = bakka itti deemtu, ykn bakka nama ykn wanti jiru (가요, 와요, 있어요).
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.prompt: Amma sarara dogoggora qabu HUNDA sirriitti deebisii barreessi. Himoota sirreeffaman Afaan Koreaatiin barreessi, gochoota eegi.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sarara dogoggora hundaaf murteessi: nama sun achitti deema moo jiraata, moo wanta achitti hojjeta?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.hint.1: Himicha kee sagalee ol-aanaadhaan dubbisi: nama sun bakka sanatti wanta hojjetaa, moo deemaa ykn jiraataa?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Gochaaf 에서 fi bakka jiraachuuf 에 fayyadameeraa?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Himni tokkoon tokkoon isaa ammallee ulfaatinaan xumurama?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.modelNote.2: Kunis gaarii dha: bakki bakka itti deemamu dha, ergasii gochi hordofa.

n-k-l1c-03.title: 지나 fi 톰 mana kitaabaa keessatti wal argan?
n-k-l1c-03.topic: Yeroo fi bakka: eenyutu eessa, yoom
n-k-l1c-03.goal: Dhugaawwan walgahii tiif barbaachisan filadhu (bakka FI yeroo namoota lamaaf), isaan wajjin murteessi, Afaan Koreaatiin sirreeffama dhiyeessi.
n-k-l1c-03.material:
Ergaawwan lama bor tiif. 오전 = ganama (a.m.), 오후 = waaree booda (p.m.), 저녁 = galgala, 시장 = gabaa, 집 = mana.

지나: 저는 내일 오전에 도서관에서 한국어를 공부해요. 오후에는 시장에 가요.
톰: 저는 내일 오전에 집에 있어요. 오후에는 도서관에 가요. 저녁에 친구를 만나요.

n-k-l1c-04.title: Kaardii himichaa tolchi: eenyu, eessa, maal

n-k-l1c-04.material: Taphni kaardii himichaa. Jechoota: 동생 = obboleessa/obboleettii xiqqaa, 공원 = paarkii, 빵 = daabboo, 카페 = kaafee, 식당 = mana nyaataa, 시장 = gabaa, 사요 = bita, 읽어요 = dubbisa.
n-k-l1c-04.thinking.2: Jijjiirama gahee ilaalcha tokkoon gaarii fakkaatu argachuu
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.prompt: Taphni kaardii himichaa seera afur qaba: (1) hojjetaa + 이/가 ykn 은/는, (2) bakka + 에서, (3) wanta + 을/를, (4) gochi dhuma irra. Himoonni kam seera afran hunda hordofu? Hunda filadhu.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.hint.0: Seera tokko tokkoon qori. Kutaa hundaa irratti mallattoo sararaa.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mallattoon tokkoon tokkoon isaa kutaa kam akka mallatteessu yaadadhu: hojjetaa, bakka, wanta.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.r.a: Wanta (빵) 을/를 hin qabu. Afaan Koreaa dubbifamu yeroo baayyee isa dhiisa, garuu seerri kaardii isa gaafata.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.r.b: Mallattoonni wal jijjiirameera: kun daabboon obboleessa nyaata jedha.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.r.d: 공원에 bakka itti deemtu mallatteessa; bakka itti nyaattu tiif kaardiin 에서 barbaada.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.explain: c fi e kutaa afran qabu: hojjetaa 동생이, bakka 공원에서, wanta 빵을, gochi 먹어요 dhuma irra. Tartiibni kutaawwan gidduu jijjiiramuu danda'a; gochi dhuma irra turti.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s2.prompt: Kaardii kee ofii tolchi. Namni (ati, hiriyyaa, maatii kee) bakka tokkotti wanta nyaatu ykn dhugu waa'ee himicha Afaan Koreaa tokko barreessi. Seera afran hunda hordofi, gochi sana -아요/어요 dhaan xumuri.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s2.hint.0: Duraan kutaa sadii murteessi: eenyu, eessa, maal.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mallattoo tokko tokkoon dabali, ergasii gochi dhuma irra kaa'i, -아요/어요 itti kenni.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hojjetaa, bakka fi wanta himicha koo keessatti agarsiisuu nan danda'aa?
n-k-l1c-04.s.s3.prompt: Hiriyyaan kutaa kee kaardii afur tolche. Kaardii tokko mallattoo dogoggoraa qaba, kanaaf gaheewwan wal makaman. Isa filadhu.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kaardii hundaa dubbisi, gaafachuun: eenyutu hojjeta, maal irratti hojjetama?

n-k-l1c-04.s.s3.explain: Sararri 3 kitaabni obboleessa dubbisa jedha: 이 책 irra jira, 를 immoo 동생 irra jira. Sirriitti: 동생이 책을 읽어요.

n-k-l1c-05.title: Eenyutu keekii nyaata? Chaatiin jijjiirama jiraata
n-k-l1c-05.topic: Eenyutu gocha hojjeta: gochaa fi mallattoo dubbisuu
n-k-l1c-05.goal: Chaatiin himicha tokko tokkoon yommuu dabalu yaada kee eenyutu gocha hojjetu deebisii sirreessi, wanta ibsame fi wanta yaadame qofa addaan baasi, himicha ukkaamsaa gaheewwan sirrii qabu barreessi.

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.prompt: Chat maatii kutaa tokko tokkoon dubbisi. Jechoota: 만들어요 = hojjata, 좋아해요 = jaallata, 먹어요 = nyaata, 안 + gochima = hin. Hanga ammaa dubbiste wajjin simatu dubbisa filadhu.
n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kutaa hanga ammaa dubbiste qofa fayyadamuun murteessi.
n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.hint.1: Filannoo hundaa gochima hima haaraa keessa jiru wajjin wal bira qabi: nyaata, hojjata, jaallata moo hin nyaatu jedhaa?

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 만들어요 eenyutu hojjata jedha. Hojjachuu fi nyaachuun gochoota adda dha.
n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ammayyuu hin beekamu; eenyutu hojjata qofa beeka.
n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Carraa caalaa 엄마 illee nyaata, sababni namoonni wanta hojjatan yeroo baay'ee nyaatu.
n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kun tilmaama amala irraa dha. Himni 엄마 hojjata qofa jedha.
n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Himni keessatti 동생 yookaan daa'imman hin eeru.

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: 좋아해요 jaallata jechuu dha. Keekii jaallachuun mallattoo gaarii dha, garuu nyaachuu wajjin wal fakkaatu miti.
n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 안 + gochima = hin. 아빠 hin nyaatu, 저 nyaata, 동생 carraa caalaa nyaata. 엄마 ammayyuu nyaataa jedhamee hin eeramne.

n-k-l1a-01.title: Junho mallattoo suuqii sagaleedhaan dubbisa
n-k-l1a-01.goal: Dubbisa tarreeffama hiriyaa kutaa keessaa dubbachiiftuu wal fakkaatan walitti makan argadhu, gosa dogoggoraa maqaa kenni, dubbisa sirrii barreessi.
n-k-l1a-01.material: Junho Hangul baratti jira. Mallattoo suuqii jaha sagalee guddaan dubbisa, dubbisa isaa jechoota cinaa barreessa. Gatii qubee fayyadamtu: ㅏ = a, ㅓ = eo (akka 'uh'), ㅗ = o, ㅜ = u, ㅣ = i, ㅡ = eu; ㄱ = g, ㄴ = n, ㄷ = d, ㅁ = m, ㅂ = b, ㄹ = r/l; cimdiin ㅇ tiin jalqabu sagalee dubbachiiftuu jalqaba. Dubbisa Junho muraasni dogoggora.
n-k-l1a-01.thinking.1: Qaama dogoggora duubatti jiru maqaa kennuu
n-k-l1a-01.prereq.0: Qubee Hangul fi sagalee isaanii bu'uuraa beeka
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarara tokko filadhu kan dubbisni Junho Hangul wajjin hin simannee. (Sararoonni tokko ol dogoggora.)
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.hint.0: Cimdii hundaa mataa kee gatii qubee wajjin dubbisi, achiis dubbisa kee dubbisa Junho wajjin wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dubbachiiftuu cimdii hundaa keessa jiru dubbisa isaa keessa jiru wajjin wal bira qabi, cimdii tokko booda tokko.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.explain: Sararoonni 2 fi 4 dogoggora. 구두 ㅜ (u) qaba, kanaaf gu-du dha, go-du miti. 거미 ㅓ (eo) qaba, kanaaf geo-mi dha, ga-mi miti. Sararoonni afran kaan wal simatu.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarara dogoggoraa hundaa keessatti qubeewwan kamtu Hangul fi dubbisa Junho gidduu jijjiirame tarreessi.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.hint.1: Jijjiiramni dubbifamaa, dubbachiiftuu yookaan tartiiba cimdii keessa jiraa?
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.a: Dubbifamaa lama wal fakkaatan (fkn ㄱ fi ㅋ) walitti makte.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.a: Dubbifamaan sararoota dogoggoraa keessa jiran (ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ) sirriitti dubbifaman (g, d, m). Jijjiiramni dubbachiiftuu keessa jira.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.b: Dubbachiiftuu wal fakkaatan walitti makte: sararri cinaa biraa yookaan fiixee biraa irra jira (ㅜ/ㅗ, ㅓ/ㅏ).
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.c: Cimdii tartiiba dogoggoraan, isa dhumaa dura dubbise.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.c: Dubbisni lamaanuu tartiiba cimdii eega (go-du tartiiba wal fakkaatu gu-du wajjin qaba). Sagaleen dubbachiiftuu qofa jijjiirame.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.d: ㅇ jalqaba cimdii irraa sagalee akka hin uumne irraanfate.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.d: Jechoonni ㅇ jalqabaa qaban (우유) sirriitti dubbifaman, sararoonni dogoggoraa ㅇ jalqabaa hin qaban.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.explain: Sararoota dogoggoraa lamaan keessatti dubbachiiftuun jijjiirame: ㅜ o ta'e, ㅓ immoo a ta'e. Lamee kun bakka sarara gabaabaan itti jiru qofa adda. Dubbachiiftuu wal fakkaatan dogoggora jalqabaa baratamaa dha.

n-k-l1a-02.title: Qubeen xiqqoo gad-aanaan faayaa qofaa?
n-k-l1a-02.topic: Hangul dubbisuu: dubbifamaa dhumaa (받침) jecha jijjiira
n-k-l1a-02.goal: Falmii hiriyaa kutaa waa'ee dubbifamaa dhumaa (받침) ragaa mallattoo gatii fi kaffaltii irraa madaali, jechoota mataa keetiin ibsi.
n-k-l1a-02.material: Gabaa irratti, Jiwoo fi Hajun mallattoo gatii korma apple irra jiru ilaalu. Lakkoofsota barbaachisan: 이 = 2, 삼 = 3, 사 = 4, 오 = 5, 천 = 1,000 (kanaaf 이천 원 = won 2,000). Jiwoo mallattoo 삼천 원 jedhee dubbisti. Hajun jedha: 'Qubeen xiqqoon cimdii jala jirtu faayaa qofa, kanaaf 삼 fi 사 wal fakkaatu, ani 사천 원 jedhee dubbisa.'
n-k-l1a-02.prereq.0: Cimdii Hangul dubbifamaa dhumaa qabu dubbisuu danda'a
n-k-l1a-02.prereq.1: Lakkoofsota 이, 삼, 사, 오 fi 천 beeka
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.prompt: Seera Hajun tarreeffama lakkoofsaa irratti qori: seerri waa'ee cimdii 삼 fi 사 maal jedha, tarreeffama wajjin simataa?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qubee jalaa 삼 quba keetiin dabali. Cimdii kamtu hafa?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cimdii sana tarreeffama lakkoofsaa wajjin wal bira qabi. Seerri ammayyuu lakkoofsa adda addaa lama kenna?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.a: Jecha wal fakkaatu ta'u, tarreeffamni wajjin simata: 삼 = 3 fi 사 = 3.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.a: Tarreeffamni kana hin jedhu. 삼 = 3 fi 사 = 4 jedha, lakkoofsota adda lama.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.b: Harkaan barreeffamuun adda fakkaatu, maxxansaan garuu cimdii wal fakkaatu.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.b: Maxxansaan illee 삼 fi 사 cimdiiwwan adda lama: tokko ㅁ jala qaba, tokko homaa hin qabu.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.c: Seera jalatti jecha wal fakkaatu ta'u, tarreeffamni garuu 삼 = 3 fi 사 = 4 kenna, kanaaf seerri kufa.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.d: Seerri isaan hin tuqu, sababni cimdii lamaanuu qubee jalaa hin qabneef.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.d: Cimdiin 삼 dubbachiiftuu jalaa ㅁ qaba. Kun qubee jalaa seerri irratti dubbatu sana.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.explain: Cimdiin Hangul akka guutuutti dubbifama, dubbifamaa dhumaa dabalatee. Qubeen jalaa faayaa yoo ta'e, 삼 fi 사 jecha wal fakkaatu ta'u, tarreeffamni garuu 삼 (sam) = 3 fi 사 (sa) = 4 jedha. Kanaaf seerri kufa; dubbisni Jiwoo 삼천 원 kaffaltii wajjin mirkaneessuu qabdu.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.prompt: Ragaan haaraan: Jiwoo won 5,000 tiin kaffalti, gurgurtichi won 2,000 isheef deebisu. Mallattoon kamtu kana deeggara?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hangam Jiwoo baasite herregi: maallaqa kaffalame hir'isii deebii.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.hint.1: Mallattoo afur keessaa kamtu hanga sanaa kenna mirkaneessi.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.r.b: Yoo kana ta'e 5,000 - 2,000 = 3,000 deebii ta'a, 2,000 miti.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.r.c: Yoo kana ta'e deebiin won 1,000 ta'a.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.r.d: Yoo kana ta'e deebiin hin jiraatu.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s2.explain: 5,000 - 2,000 = 3,000. Kaffaltiin dubbisa Jiwoo 삼천 원 wajjin walii gala, 사천 원 Hajun wajjin miti, kanaaf qubeen jalaa barbaachisaa ture.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.prompt: Himoota tokko yookaan lama keessatti, Hajun tiif ibsi maaliif qubeen jalaa faayaa miti. Mallattoo 삼천 원 akka fakkeenya fayyadami.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.hint.0: 삼 fi 사 qubee qubeedhaan wal bira qabi.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.hint.1: Qubeen dabalataa cimdii maal akka dabaluu fi cimdiin hundi lakkoofsa kam akka ta'e jedhi.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Qubeen jalaa cimdii maal akka godhu jedheettaa?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Lamee cimdii akka 삼 fi 사 tiin agarsiifteettaa?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.model.0: Qubeen jalaa ㅁ kutaa cimdii dha. Isa malee cimdiin 사 (4) dha; wajjin immoo 삼 (3) dha. Kanaaf mallattoon won 3,000 jedha, won 4,000 miti.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.model.1: 삼 fi 사 jechoota adda: 삼 = 3 fi 사 = 4. Qubeen jalaa lakkoofsa jijjiira, kanaaf faayaa miti.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s3.model.2: Qubeen jalaa jecha jijjiira: 가 fi 간 jechoota adda. Akkasumas 삼 (3) fi 사 (4) adda, kanaaf qubeen jalaa barbaachisaa dha.

n-k-l1a-03.title: Mallattoo cabe balbala gubbaa
n-k-l1a-03.topic: Hangul dubbisuu: cimdii birqabaa mallattoo keessa
n-k-l1a-03.goal: Odeeffannoo mallattoo walakkaan haguugame dubbisuuf barbaachisu murteessi, wanta mirkanaa'e beektu himi, mallattoo dhumaa yeroo dabalataan mul'atu dubbisi.
n-k-l1a-03.material: Mallattoon balbala gubbaa mana gurgurtaa guddaa keessa cabeera. Cimdii jalqabaa lama qofa dubbisuu dandeessa: 화장. Jechoonni lama kutaa kana irratti kanaan jalqabu: 화장실 (mana xuraa'aa) fi 화장품 (meeshaa miidhagsuu). Mana xuraa'aa barbaadda.
n-k-l1a-03.thinking.1: Wanta mirkanaa'e fi hin mirkanoofne addaan baasuu
n-k-l1a-03.prereq.1: 화장실 fi 화장품 akka jechoota beeka
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.prompt: Kanneen kana keessaa kamtu mallattoon jecha kam akka jedhu addaan baasuuf si gargaara?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.hint.0: Jechoota danda'aman lamaan walitti jalaa barreessi, wanta wal fakkaatu jala sarari.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kutaan mallattoo kamtu jechoota lamaan gidduu adda ta'uu danda'a gaafadhu.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.o.a: Cimdii jalqabaa lamaan (화장) deebi'ii suuta dubbisuu.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.r.a: Jechoonni lamaanuu cimdii lamaan wal fakkaatuun jalqabu, 화장, kanaaf deebi'ii dubbisuun jechoota addaan baasuu hin danda'u.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.o.b: Cimdii 화장 booda mallattoo irra dhufu arguu.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.r.c: Halluun kutaa jecha barreeffame miti; balbaloonni halluu kamiyyuu jecha lamaan keessaa kamiyyuu baachuu danda'u.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.r.d: Kutaan eessa akka jirtu sitti hima malee mallattoon cabe jecha lamaan keessaa kamtu agarsiisu miti.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s1.explain: Jechoonni lamaan cimdii sadaffaa qofa irratti adda (실 yookaan 품). Cimdiin jalqabaa lamaan qooddatamu, kanaaf cimdiin sadaffaa qofa murteessuu danda'a.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.prompt: Hiriyaan tokko bilbilee gaafata: 'Mallattoon maal jedha?' Hima gabaabaa tokko yookaan lama keessatti (Afaan Koreaa yookaan Afaan Ingiliffaa) deebisi: wanta mirkanaa'ee dubbisuu dandeessu fi hin dandeenye himi.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.hint.0: Cimdii kamtu dubbisuu akka dandeessu himi.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.hint.1: Wanta ammayyuu arguu barbaaddu jecha maqaa kennuu dura dabali.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kutaa dubbisuu danda'u fi hin dandeenye addaan baasteettaa?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ragaa malee jecha tokko filachuu irraa of eegdeettaa?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.model.0: 화장 dubbisuu nan danda'a, garuu bloka sadaffaa amma illee hin beeku. 화장실 ykn 화장품 ta'uu danda'a.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.model.1: Blokawwan lamaan duraa 화장 jedhu. Jecha guutuu bloka sadaffaa osoo hin argin jechuu hin danda'u.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s2.model.3: 화장 dubbisuu nan danda'a garuu bloka sadaffaa amma illee hin danda'u; jecha beekuuf isa arguu barbaada.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.prompt: Dhoksaan socho'eera fi bloka sadaffaa mul'ata. ㅍ (olii), ㅜ (qubee-sagalee) fi ㅁ (gadii) irraa hojjetame dha. Balbala kami?
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qubee olii, qubee-sagalee fi qubee gadii bloka tokkootti walitti kaa'i.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bloka sana blokawwan filatamoo lama 실 fi 품 waliin wal-bira qabi.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.r.a: Jechi mana fincaanii bloka 실 qaba; qubeewwan kennaman bloka adda, 품, uuman.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.o.b: Tokko isaanii; blokawwan lamaan duraa gahaa dha.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.r.b: Bloka sadaffaan jechoota lama gidduu murteessa fi amma mul'ata.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.o.d: Lamaanuu miti; mallattoon dubbifamuu hin danda'u.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.r.d: Blokawwan sadanuu amma dubbifamu, kanaaf mallattoon dubbifamuu danda'a.
n-k-l1a-03.s.s3.explain: Qubeewwan ㅍ + ㅜ + ㅁ bloka 품 uuma, kanaaf mallattoon 화장품 (meeshaa miidhagsuu) jedha. Mana fincaanii balbala kana duubatti hin jiru.

n-k-l1a-04.title: Waraqaan dhaaba mana nyaataa irra jiru
n-k-l1a-04.topic: Hangul dubbisuu: mallattoo jecha tokko ykn lama, blokawwan wal-fakkaatan
n-k-l1a-04.goal: Waraqaa dhoksame tarkaanfii sadiin dubbisi, osoo hin ariifatin murteessuu hin dhiisin, fi akkamitti jechoonni lama wal-fakkaatan (있어요, 없어요) hiika akka jijjiiran hubadhu.
n-k-l1a-04.material: Waraqaan dhaaba mana nyaataa irratti maxxanfame. Harki baay'ee isaa dhoksa fi yeroo hundaa xiqqoo socho'a. Jechoota si barbaachisan: 있어요 = jira, 없어요 = hin jiru.
n-k-l1a-04.prereq.0: Blokawwan Hangul qubee dhumaa qaban dubbisuu ni danda'a
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.prompt: Kutaa tokko tokkoo dubbisi, deebii wanta hanga ammaa dubbisuu dandeessu waliin simatu filadhu, ergasii itti fufi.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.hint.0: Qubeewwan hanga ammaa argitan qofa fayyadami.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.hint.1: Of gaafadhu maal bloka wal-fakkaataa ykn jecha wal-fakkaataan jalqabuu danda'a.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 김 김치, 김밥, fi maqaa maatii baay'ee baratamaa 김 jalqaba. Bloka tokko murteessuuf xiqqaa dha, kanaaf eegu filannoo madaalamaa dha.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ammaaf himuu hin danda'u; jecha tokko caalaa 김 tiin jalqaba.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Maqaa maatii: 김 maqaa maatii baratamaa dha.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Maqaan maatii tilmaama biraa dha. Bloka tokko maqaa, 김치 ykn 김밥 ta'uu hin agarsiisu.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Harki socho'a. Amma jecha jalqabaa dubbisuu dandeessa: 김치
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Mata-duree (kimchi) beekta, garuu waa'ee isaa maal akka jedhame hin beekne. Jechi itti aanu isa jedha.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Waraqaan waa'ee kimchi dha, garuu waa'ee isaa maal akka jedhu hin beeku.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Amma illee homtuu 'gatii hir'ate' hin jedhu. Waraqaan nyaata maqaa moggaasu menu, gatii, akeekkachiisa, ykn beeksisa ta'uu danda'a.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Amma illee jecha bilisaa ykn gatii hin jiru.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Amma illee jecha mi'aa hin jiru.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Harki fagaata. Waraqaan guutuu: 김치 없어요.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 없어요 (hin jiru) qubee gadii ㅂ + ㅅ qaba; 있어요 (jira) ㅆ qofa qaba. Waraqaan kimchi hin jiru jedha.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Jechi dhumaa qubee-sagalee jala qubee lama (ㅂ fi ㅅ) qaba, kanaaf 없어요 dha, 있어요 miti. Jechoonni lamaan wal-fakkaatu garuu hiika faallaa qabu.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waraqaa irratti waa'ee gatii homtuu hin jiru.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waraqaan homaa hin gaafatu; wanta tokko hanqachuu qofa jedha.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s1.reflect: Bloka jalqabaa yeroo baay'ee mallattoo guutuu hin himu, fi maqaan nyaataa qofti waraqaan waa'ee isaa maal akka jedhu hin himu. Jechi dhumaa hiika murteesse, fi bifa wal-fakkaataa isaa irraa qubee gadii qofaan adda ture.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s2.prompt: Wanta waraqaan jedhu jechoota mataa keetiin (Ingilizii ykn Koriyaa) barreessi. Ergasii jecha hiika murteessu maqaa moggaasi.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dura ergaa guutuu Afaan Ingilizii tiin jedhi.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ergasii jecha jijjiiramuun ergaa gara faallaatti garagalchu tokko agarsiisi.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s2.model.0: Kimchi hin jiru jedha. Jechi dhumaa 없어요 murteessa; 있어요 faallaa jechuu ta'a.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s2.model.1: 김치 없어요 = kimchi hin jiru. Jecha lammaffaa, 없어요, isa barbaachisaa dha.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s2.model.2: Kimchi dhumeera. Jechi xumuraa (없어요) na himata, jecha jalqabaa miti.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.prompt: Waraqaan biraa akkasuma dhoksameera. 물 dubbisuu dandeessa, ergasii jecha dhoksame 있어요 ykn 없어요 dha. Waraqaan maal akka jedhu jechuu dura maal arguu qabda?
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ergaawwan danda'aman lama tokko jala tokko barreessi fi wanta adda jala sararii.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kutaan waraqaa kamtu ergaa tokko gara isa kaanitti jijjiiruu danda'a gaafadhu.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.o.a: Qubeewwan gadii jecha dhoksame: qubee tokko (ㅆ) ykn lama (ㅂ + ㅅ).
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.o.b: Bloka jalqabaa 물 irra deebi'ii, suuta dubbisi.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.r.b: 물 duraanuu dubbisuu dandeessa. Irra deebi'ee dubbisuun jechoota dhumaa lamaan keessaa isa dhoksame hin agarsiisu.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.r.c: Halluun ergaa barreeffamaa keessa hin jiru.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.o.d: Homtuu dabalataa; 물 qofti bishaan akka jiru natti hima.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.r.d: Maqaan dhugaatii ykn nyaataa mata-duree qofa kenna. 있어요 fi 없어요 hiika faallaa qabu.
n-k-l1a-04.s.s3.explain: 물 mata-duree qofa kenna. Jechoonni dhumaa lamaan wal-fakkaatu fi qubee gadiitiin adda, kanaaf qubee sana arguu qabda waraqaan bishaan jira ykn hin jiru jedha beekuuf.

n-k-l1a-05.title: Kutaa keetiif qormaata wal-fakkaachuu hojjedhu
n-k-l1a-05.topic: Hangul dubbisuu: qubee-sagalee-hin-taane wal-fakkaatan fi wal-fakkaachuu qormaata
n-k-l1a-05.goal: Wal-fakkaachuu qormaataa gaarii filadhu, wal-fakkaachuu jechoota Koriyaa dhugaa mataa kee uumi, fi akkamitti addaan baasuu akka dandeessu ibsi.
n-k-l1a-05.material: Barsiisaan kee barataa hundaa wal-fakkaachuu qormaataa tokko akka hojjetu gaafata: jechoota Koriyaa dhugaa lama kan baay'ee wal-fakkaatan, sababni qubee tokko qofa adda ta'eef. Fakkeenya yaadaa: 가 fi 나 (qubee tokko adda).
n-k-l1a-05.prereq.0: Jechoota Hangul salphaa muraasa ni beeka
n-k-l1a-05.prereq.1: Bifa ㅁ/ㅂ, ㅏ/ㅓ, ㄴ/ㄷ beekuu ni danda'a
n-k-l1a-05.s.s1.prompt: Lamaan kamtu wal-fakkaachuu qormaata gaarii dha?
n-k-l1a-05.s.s1.hint.0: Filannoo tokko tokkoo keessatti jechoota lamaan gidduu maaltu hafu fi maaltu jijjiirama barreessi.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s1.hint.1: Wal-fakkaachuun gaariin garaagarummaa quba kee tiin agarsiisuu dandeessu qaba.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s1.r.a: Bloka hundi adda; kun wal-fakkaachuu miti.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s1.r.c: Jecha tokko isa kaan keessa jira fi dheerinni adda; kun qubee tokkoon garaagarummaa miti.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s1.r.d: Jechoonni lamaan akkuma wal-fakkaatu barreeffamu, kanaaf namni tokko illee dubbisuun addaan baasuu hin danda'u.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s1.explain: 물 fi 불 lamaanuu jechoota dhugaa dha fi qubee jalqabaa qofa adda (ㅁ vs ㅂ). Qormaata gaarii jechoota dhugaa lama, garaagarummaa xiqqaa tokko, fi garaagarummaa quba keetiin agarsiisuu dandeessu barbaada.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s2.prompt: Lamaan mataa kee uumi: jechoota Koriyaa dhugaa lama qubee tokkoon adda ta'an barreessi (lamaan hojii kana keessatti hin maxxanfamne), fi hiika Ingilizii isaanii dabali.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s2.hint.0: Jecha gaarii beektu yaadi fi qubee isaa tokko jijjiiri.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bloka haaraan jecha dhugaa ta'uu isaa mirkaneessi.
n-k-l1a-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jechoonni lamaanuu jechoota Koriyaa dhugaa ani beeku?
